title: rosa alpina var. globosa
intro: Rosa alpina var. globosa, commonly known as Alpine Rose, is a fragrant, flowering plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Rosa alpina var. globosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exert anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative effects. The plant's bioactive constituents also possess antimicrobial and antiviral properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for wound healing and immune system support.
